filters.name: at
filters.description: Resolve the map AS OF this date — rows whose [effective_from, effective_to) window covers it, null bounds open. This is THE translation query: pass the ORDER's date, because a listing that swapped products means different things on different days. Without an explicit status filter, `at` returns live rows only — an archived (withdrawn) pairing never described the listing.
